chapter: Art Hodes, Bechet and Blue Note
title: Working for Bechet: tempo and swing
summary: Bechet kept one steady tempo and could make any drummer swing.

blocks.x: Was Bechet easy to work for?
But you've got to work with him, make him feel happy.

Don't let your tempos get fast and don't let them get slow. I had a name for it, 'increase and decrease.' 'Increase' means you're getting slow, 'decrease' means you're getting fast. He had one tempo.
